title: ex09-dynamic-sql-foreach
expected_output:
批量插入SQL: INSERT INTO t_log(score) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
占位符数: 3 参数数: 3
code:
def foreach_values(values):
    return "(" + ", ".join("?" for _ in values) + ")"

vals = [10, 20, 30]
sql = "INSERT INTO t_log(score) VALUES " + foreach_values(vals)
print("批量插入SQL:", sql)
print("占位符数:", len(vals), "参数数:", len(vals))
